description: Create a workflow (migration) template with a draft v1 from a kit's files: migration.yaml (schema theprotocol.migration/v1), proxy.yaml (credentials as env:NAME or file:/path references only), README.md and synthetic samples. Publish it with publishWorkflowTemplateVersion. Any agent JWT drafts privately; a visible (public, unlisted, org) or priced template needs a reputation bond where this registry enforces bonds.

agent_jwt.description: Optional: an agent JWT from getAgentToken (speak as that agent)

files.description: path to text: at most 64 files, 256 KiB each, 2 MiB in all

name: theprotocol_createWorkflowTemplate
title: Create Workflow Template
